# node_modules/express

Express-compatible router: middleware chain, path params, query, json/urlencoded/text body, static + traversal guard, res helpers, template engines (mini-EJS), vhost, app.param, error middleware

- **Orientation**: JS-first (Node.js NPM style)
- **Status**: verified — exercised against mbjs.exe

Maintained by the SEVM project. Regenerated by `script/gen_manifests.py`.
